title: Accept captured Logs and mirrored error ownership
question: Do Logs and mirrored RUM errors retain emission view/action ownership through deferred context writes and message delivery, with bounded documented nil and source-less policies?
source_audit: RemoteLogger.internalLog captures a core-owned handoff on the caller thread, then uses it in the asynchronous event write. Source-less work uses the ordered Core context read.
Pending action merge requires exact application/session/view identity and excludes the preceding action.

RUM error messages carry private view/action/scene/captured metadata after customer lookalikes are removed; ErrorMessageReceiver strips metadata and routes the captured target/action independently of current representative.
Known scene with nil snapshot can route only to that scene; nil without scene targets none. Ordinary no-view process contexts retain legacy off-view handling.
No SDK defect established. Add decisive regression tests before any repair.
unit_contract: Deferred A/B info/error writes retain four exact application/session/view/action log payloads and two mirror envelopes after opposite or foreign context changes; include retirement after emission.
Explicit nil stays uncorrelated and never takes peer action; foreign or retired-at-emission handoffs retain the consumer fallback, and source-less uses ordered consumer context.

Deliver captured A/B mirror envelopes in reverse order after peer representative/action churn; assert exact event owner/action and no private-key leakage, including captured nil action and unavailable captured owner.

native_contract.owners: Two independent mapper Homes plus live snapshot action IDs. Assert B represents when A logs are emitted. Require an empty task handoff and an independently observed process representative for source-less logs. Source labels never prove ownership.
native_contract.limits: Serial native scenes; deterministic deferred tests supply controlled asynchronous churn. No simultaneous hardware claim or Flutter claim.

workflow: Predeclare precise native guards/expectations before fixture; add existing repository DatadogLogs product only to owned probe project; mapper Foundation wire projection; freeze source/contract before clean install, complete Logs run inventory and full RUM session check.
preflight: Authenticated Logs DDSQL read PASS; no positive Logs from this service available in the bounded schema probe.
closure: Only close T09 after focused/affected tests and strict local/backend acceptance; preserve all invalid/inconclusive attempts.
